composition_variation: Portray Roronoa Zoro taking a quiet tea break in a jade-colored garden pavilion, with his recognizable green hair and relaxed expression. Dress him in a fully closed dark green casual robe. Place a small ceramic cup in one hand; show no swords or weapon fittings. Render layered bamboo shadows, wet garden stones, and moss with elegant ink outlines and restrained watercolor. Build an original peaceful portrait wallpaper, never a replica of existing artwork. Keep the upper 28% empty and quiet for the clock. Design at 1024x1536 for the central x158-866 crop, with the face inside x240-784. No text, logos, UI, weapons, violence, or extra characters.
